_metadata.description: Fleet structural intelligence (deterministic offender rollups) and the resource-aware startup-performance benchmark, decoupled from the test phase.

requirements.title: Aggregate fleet conformance and distributions
requirements.description: FleetService.ScanFleet rolls up offenders, profile/surface distribution, per-rule conformance, and auto-fixable coverage across discovered scenarios via deterministic structured queries — not a search-hub data provider.

validation.notes: fleet/fleet_test.go asserts the scan aggregates rollups and distributions and requires a validation engine.

requirements.title: Fleet scan is resilient to per-scenario errors
requirements.description: A scenario that fails to scan is recorded as an error and the fleet scan continues over the remaining scenarios rather than aborting the whole rollup.

validation.notes: fleet/fleet_test.go asserts a failing scenario is recorded and the scan continues.

requirements.title: Record resource-aware startup measurements
requirements.description: BenchmarkStartup restarts a scenario behind a runner seam and persists per-surface time-to-healthy plus a common.v1.ExecutionMetrics resource envelope to the SQLite trend store; GetPerfTrend reads measurements newest-first and scoped per scenario.

validation.notes: perf/perf_test.go covers store round-trip, newest-first scoping, and a faked-runner benchmark persist with injected metrics.

requirements.title: Benchmark refuses to measure structure-health itself
requirements.description: The benchmark rejects a request to restart structure-health itself (self-restart deadlock guard) and surfaces runner errors rather than hanging.

validation.notes: perf/perf_test.go asserts the self-benchmark rejection and the runner-error path.
